title: eludite.agents.configure input
description: Change the running agent's session mode or one of its session config options (ACP `session/set_mode` or `session/set_config_option`), as the Agents window's pickers under the prompt box do: the model, the effort, the mode. Answers the state (agents-state.output.json) once the agent has answered, so its `mode` or `options` show the new value; fails with the agent's message otherwise: `busy` while a turn runs, `unknown option` for an option the agent does not offer, `unknown value` for a value the option does not list, `not supported` for an agent that offers no modes or config options. A choice made through this command is not remembered in the settings `agents.model` and `agents.effort`; only a choice made in the window is.

option.description: `mode` for the session mode, else a config option's id from the state's `options` (for example `model` or `effort`).

value.description: A mode id from the state's `mode.available`, or a value from the option's `choices`.
